boundary_rule: extend a winning outer deep LR geometrically by a factor of two until the winner is interior

leave_one_out.kind: four leave-one-cap-out fits; diagnostic envelope, not a confidence interval

practical_ceiling.compute_definition: largest cap with input tokens no greater than 2x cap 16
practical_ceiling.extrapolation_definition: one doubling beyond the largest observed cap
practical_ceiling.support_definition: largest cap retained by at least half of users

cap_fit.selection_reason: bounded cap-32 boundary probe; no target-attainment claim

sensitivity.kind: all 16 independent ±0.003 corners; sensitivity, not a confidence interval

resolved_diagnostics.explanation: the selected checkpoints are later at caps 8 and 16, but each expanded treatment reached the preceding treatment's selected quality in fewer epochs and then continued to a higher peak; the matched-quality epoch crossings do not imply lower work because larger caps used more optimizer steps and targets

selection_rule: validation Recall@100, then same-epoch NDCG@100, then lower logged horizon training time

timing_definition.steady_state_targets_per_second: candidate targets divided by logged train time over epochs 2-20; epoch 1 is excluded
timing_definition.time_through_selected_checkpoint_seconds: logged train, validation inference, and validation save time through the validation-selected checkpoint
timing_definition.total_required_training_wall_seconds: Prepared-stage to Final-metrics wall time summed over every LR-tuning and boundary artifact required for the treatment
